title: Hybrid ingress prefetch and kernel telemetry ops for embedding endpoint p99 reduction
creator: Maya Chen
description: Reduce p99 latency on the embeddings endpoint by combining an ingress-side hybrid prefetcher (micro-slicing requests + opportunistic KV prewarm) with kernel-parameter telemetry and dynamic kernel parameterization. Focus on tail events caused by cold KV cache, sequence-length variance, and kernel dispatch mispredictions.
acceptance_criteria: Embedding endpoint aggregate p99 reduced from baseline (~320ms) to <=140ms on standard tenant workload (seq avg 64, seq 95% 128) under 75% load
No >10% regression on throughput or median latency across synthetic and canary workloads
Telemetry shows kernel-level dispatch latencies and KV prewarm hit-rate metrics in dashboards
A/B rollout plan and rollback triggers documented and validated in staging
notes: 2025-11-05 - Kickoff: scoped as a hybrid change (ingress + runtime). Decided to avoid large GC or allocator changes in this cycle. Focus on micro-slicing (split large batch windows into smaller micro-slices) + per-shard KV prefetch heuristics.

2025-11-07 - Profiling: NVTX traces and per-kernel timing on a 8xA100 staging pool identified ~45ms variance from kernel selection in 8% of requests (mispredicted kernel path due to unexpected seq length). Also found cold-KV miss causing 60-120ms tail in ~2% of requests.

2025-11-09 - Design decision: implement ingress micro-slicer with adaptive thresholds (based on per-tenant ingress rate and recent seq-length histogram) and a lightweight KV prefetch hint to runtime. Avoid global prewarming to keep cost low.

2025-11-11 - Implementation: ingress changes in gateway service (GH PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/gateway/pull/1428). Runtime kernel hinting and telemetry in runtime repo (GH PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/1789).

2025-11-13 - Telemetry: added kernel dispatch latency histogram and 'kv_prefetch_hit' counters to metrics collector. Dashboard prototype: https://grafana.redwood.local/d/embeddings/ingress-kernel-telemetry

2025-11-15 - Experiments: synthetic replay of 10M embedding requests (seq distribution matching production) shows p99 reduce from 322ms -> 128ms with hybrid prefetch + tuned kernel params; throughput steady at -3% median change. Noted 0.6% increase in short-tail median for small sequences (investigate micro-slicer hysteresis).
2025-11-16 - Review feedback from Runtime team (Ana Patel): request to add fallback disable flag for prefetch hints when KV bucket load crosses threshold. Added flag and canary gating.

2025-11-18 - Canary deploy planned: rollout to 5% of production traffic in EU region with automatic rollback trigger if p99 or error rate increases >10% over baseline for 5m window. Responsible on-call: Rafael Ortega.
